RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel is not proof of discrimination on its own, but it can be a procedural red flag, especially if civil service policy mandates diverse recruitment panels. The successful candidate had relevant experience, so the hiring decision may have been entirely merit-based.

Before alleging bias, first follow up on your request for written feedback. Once received, evaluate whether their stated rationale is objective and aligns with the job criteria. If the feedback is vague, inconsistent, or if ministry guidelines required a gender-balanced panel, you then have legitimate grounds to raise procedural irregularities or request a formal review through HR or your union.
